name: one-of-a-kind-fashion
description: ONE OF A KIND FASHION — Canadian ethnic fashion e-commerce platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --prefix apps/api" "npm run dev --prefix apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix packages/shared && npm run build --prefix apps/api && npm run build --prefix apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix packages/shared && npm run test --prefix apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix packages/shared && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/api && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/web
